articles.title: Jaipur to host its first Army Day parade on January 15
articles.summary: Jaipur will host the Army Day parade for the first time on January 15th at Mahal Road, a significant move to bring this national event beyond Delhi. This offers a unique opportunity for citizens to witness the Indian Army's capabilities and discipline firsthand. The festivities have already begun with community outreach programs like medical camps, underscoring the Army's dedication to both national security and public welfare, providing valuable insight for aspiring officers.

articles.title: COAI flags concerns over Prasar Bharati’s direct-to-mobile test
articles.summary: Telecom industry body COAI expressed concerns regarding public broadcaster Prasar Bharati's direct-to-mobile (DtM) technology test. COAI criticized the trial for not involving telecom operators, citing potential issues with spectrum usage and existing infrastructure. DtM aims to deliver broadcast content directly to smartphones without requiring cellular data. This highlights the need for inter-agency collaboration in evolving digital service delivery.

articles.title: Army procurement probe: 26 companies being investigated, says MACC
articles.summary: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) in Kuala Lumpur has launched an investigation into 26 companies. These firms are suspected of involvement in corrupt practices related to the procurement of army projects. This probe highlights ongoing efforts against corruption in defence acquisition within Malaysia, a critical area for national security and public trust.

articles.title: 10 Best Netflix Documentaries of 2025
articles.summary: Netflix showcased numerous documentary films and series throughout 2025, with this list detailing the top 10. Documentaries constitute a significant and popular genre on the platform. While focusing on entertainment, SSB aspirants can leverage documentaries to enhance general knowledge and understanding of global affairs, fostering a well-rounded perspective essential for selection.

articles.title: Dollar Supremacy Strategy or All-Time Grift? American AI Imperialism’s Reliance on the Middle East
articles.summary: The global AI revolution requires immense capital, land, and power. Gulf nations like Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the UAE are strategically stepping forward to supply these essential resources. This move positions them as crucial players and enablers in the burgeoning field of artificial intelligence, leveraging their financial might. Their involvement is poised to significantly shape AI's future development and international dynamics.

articles.title: Kathryn Bigelow, Catastrophe Connoisseur
articles.summary: Director Kathryn Bigelow and arms-control expert Alexandra Bell possess significant knowledge of nuclear-attack submarines. Bigelow's new Netflix film, 'A House of Dynamite,' reportedly explores a hypothetical scenario involving the U.S. government. This highlights the intersection of strategic defence, expert analysis, and media representation, relevant for understanding national security dynamics and future military capabilities, particularly regarding naval power.
